properties.name: A test whose criteria moved after its data reads unknown until the owner acknowledges the change with a reason
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-10-20 ("Go with your recommendations", option b of dec:idea-should-a-criterion-changed-after-the-data-move-the-tests-reading)
properties.statement: When a hypothesis test's locked criteria (its α Constraint's limit or statement, what the check verifies, its governing test Decision, or the record re-attached at another α) change after its data arrived, the test reads unknown ("its criteria moved after the data") and supports nothing above it until the owner acknowledges the criteria_changed_after_data gap with a reason; once acknowledged it reads as it did before. Every write still lands; nothing is refused. A change made before the data changes nothing, as today.
